    Behind the suggestions

    These gentle defaults are designed for lower-energy days, not scientific measurements. Rest is welcome at any level. Travel, queues and bookings take extra effort.

    EnergyWeekdays / before or after workWeekend
    0–10%Rest, music or a seat by the windowRest first. No preparation tasks.
    15–25%A short walk, breakfast en route or an episode at homeA nearby park bench or a drink
    30–45%Books, doodling or a movie if time allowsA park stroll or small exhibition
    50–65%Comedy or a beginner workshopExplore one neighborhood
    70–100%Casual badminton with a friend, if time allowsBeginner hike: 80%+ and at least 210 minutes

    Energy, timing and total duration come first; matching wishes get priority after that. Unrecognized wishes stay saved, without becoming research tasks.
